title: pvWriteCGNSWriter
body:
## pvWriteCGNSWriter

Explicit-export writer for CGNS (.cgns), the CFD General Notation System read by many solvers, meshers and post-processors. It accepts structured grids, polygonal data, unstructured grids, or a multiblock containing these, and stores mesh and point/cell solution fields in one file, using HDF5 storage by default (UseHDF5) or the older ADF layout. Publication uses the semantic contract: ParaView re-reads the file and geometry plus every input point and cell field are compared, accepting changes in block structure, point identity, connectivity order and storage type. Use it to hand results to CGNS-based tools; use pvWriteXMLUnstructuredGridWriter or pvWriteXMLMultiBlockDataWriter when the data only needs to round-trip through VTK.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Image and rectilinear grids are outside the documented input types; convert them to a structured or unstructured grid first.
- ParaView notes that the CGNS writer may not support ghost levels; leave GhostLevel at 0.
- Keep UseHDF5 true unless the receiving tool can only read ADF-based CGNS files.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with default options; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `CGNSWriter`. Identity: `writers/CGNSWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellDataArrays` | Select the cell data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ChooseArraysToWrite` | Explicitly choose which arrays to write. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `EdgeDataArrays` | Select the edge data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FieldDataArrays` | Select the field data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `GhostLevel` | The number of ghost levels to include in the output file(s). Note that some writers (such as ExodusIIWriter and CGNSWriter) may not support writing ghost levels. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `PointDataArrays` | Select the point data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `RowDataArrays` | Select the row data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `UseHDF5` | When UseHDF5 is turned ON, the CGNS file will use HDF5 as the underlying file format. When turned OFF, the file will use ADF as the underlying file format. HDF5 is preferred and default. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `VertexDataArrays` | Select the vertex data arrays to pass through. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "semantic",
  "extensions": [
    "cgns"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [
    "structure",
    "point-identity",
    "connectivity-order",
    "storage-type"
  ],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteCGNSWriter",
  "acceptLosses": [
    "structure",
    "point-identity",
    "connectivity-order",
    "storage-type"
  ]
}
```
